# Ashton Spina

> Marketplace engineering leader and consultant based in Helsinki, Finland. Founder of TechTactics Oy, through which he offers fractional engineering leadership, marketplace merger and integration work, B2B monetisation and platform builds.

## Work

- [Consulting and track record](https://www.ashtonspina.com/?mode=work): services, case study and experience.
- Fractional Head of Engineering: interim or part-time engineering leadership for marketplace teams.
- Marketplace mergers and integration: part of the homegate.ch and immoscout24.ch merger that formed SMG Real Estate, and of its later acquisition of flatfox.
- B2B monetisation and product: led engineering for SMG's Real Estate B2B line, around 40% of group revenue.
- Build and modernise platforms: built Homegate's AWS Cognito authentication; builds and runs JobCrawls.

## Experience

- TechTactics Oy, Founder (full-time since 2026; previously alongside SMG as the company behind JobCrawls)
- SMG Swiss Marketplace Group, Head of Engineering, Real Estate B2B (2022–2026)
- Homegate AG, Engineering Manager (2020–2022) and Full-Stack Software Engineer (2019–2020)
- Belsimpel (Gomibo), Technical Lead and developer (2018–2019)
- University of Groningen, Teaching Assistant (2017–2018)

## Products

- [JobCrawls](https://jobcrawls.com): Finland's job market aggregated from company career pages, with AI-extracted structured data.
- [Conjugr8](https://conjugr8.com): a verb and grammar trainer for Romance languages, built for fast repetition.
